title: Berhujah & Berunding
canDo: Construct and defend a structured argument
Use advanced connectors and hedging for nuanced argument
lifeBenefit: Argue a position persuasively and negotiate complex situations with confidence.

vocab.exampleEn: I object to that proposal because...

vocab.example: Walau bagaimanapun, kita perlu pertimbangkan kos.
vocab.exampleEn: However, we need to consider the cost.

vocab.example: Ada bukti untuk sokong dakwaan tu?
vocab.exampleEn: Is there evidence to support that claim?

vocab.example: Mungkin kita perlukan kompromi di sini.
vocab.exampleEn: Perhaps we need a compromise here.

vocab.example: Pada hemat saya, kita patut tunggu dulu.
vocab.exampleEn: In my opinion, we should wait first.

practiceExercises.prompt: Translate: 'In my opinion, this argument is strong.'
practiceExercises.answer: Pada hemat saya, hujah ni kukuh.

practiceExercises.prompt: Translate: 'I support the idea; however, we need more evidence.'
practiceExercises.answer: Saya menyokong idea tu; walau bagaimanapun, kita perlukan lebih bukti.

scenario.setting: A structured mini-debate on whether remote work should be permanent

script.ms: Pada hemat saya, kerja dari rumah patut jadi kekal.
script.en: In my opinion, working from home should become permanent.

script.ms: Saya faham hujah awak, walau bagaimanapun, ramai kehilangan semangat berpasukan.
script.en: I understand your argument, however, many lose team spirit.

script.ms: Itu andaian sahaja. Ada bukti produktiviti sebenarnya meningkat.
script.en: That's just an assumption. There's evidence productivity actually increased.

script.ms: Mungkin kita perlukan kompromi — hibrid, tiga hari pejabat, dua hari rumah.
script.en: Maybe we need a compromise — hybrid, three days office, two days home.

script.ms: Itu cadangan yang munasabah. Saya boleh terima itu.
script.en: That's a reasonable proposal. I can accept that.

scenario.aiPrompt: You are an articulate debate opponent arguing for permanent remote work. Present a clear argument, respond to counterpoints with evidence, and be willing to accept a well-reasoned compromise. Standard, formal-debate register.

speakingPrompts.instructions: Shadow the debate dialogue, focusing on formal argumentative structure and connectors.
Debate a topic of your choice with the AI opponent persona, using at least two argument connectors.
rubric: uses at least two connectors (walau bagaimanapun/pada hemat saya/dsb.)

speakingPrompts.instructions: Deliver a 2-minute structured argument for a position of your choice: claim, evidence, acknowledge counterpoint, conclusion.

questions.prompt: Translate: 'In my opinion, we need more evidence.'
questions.answer: Pada hemat saya, kita perlukan lebih bukti.
